data.standardized_narrative: As at 31 December 2018 gross claims outstanding opened at GBP 107.4m and experienced a material adverse re-estimation for prior underwriting years (2016 and earlier) resulting in a gross strengthening of approximately GBP 42.7m (39.8% of opening reserves). The movement was driven principally by adverse development on casualty and property lines reflecting US catastrophe activity (notably 2017 events such as Hurricanes Irma and Harvey) and IBNR / reserving recalibration, partially offset by some favourable movements in specific older years.
raw_causal_phrases: Loss experience has been impacted by the US Cat events Hurricanes Florence and Michael and California Wildfires
The 2016 year of account has been impacted by the 2017 US Cat activity (most significantly Hurricanes Irma and Harvey), making up cGBP 6m of the loss.

The most uncertain element within these technical provisions is the amount for claims outstanding which covers amounts where either the claim has been notified to the syndicate or where there has not yet been a notification or although notified there has been insufficient information to date to be certain regarding its ultimate costs.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative estimates computed as paid + outstanding). The technical provisions reconciliation (movement in gross provision) was not used as it includes current-year movements; the P&L 'claims incurred in relation to prior underwriting years' lines were also avoided per instructions. The triangle in the report is ragged (development ages vary by column) and some rows in the printed table are irregularly aligned in the source PDF parsing; the PYD figure therefore uses the cumulative estimates (paid + outstanding) and previous-diagonal comparison for underwriting years 2016 and older. There is potential distortion risk from reinsurance-to-close activity referenced elsewhere; this may affect comparability. Where per-LOB PYD amounts were not explicitly provided, LOB movements are directional only and amounts are null.
